items.name: Cookie Bite
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: individual original cosmetic skin concept for the mobile game Hole Feast, Common rarity, for an art review.
Create a clean square 3D game-asset beauty render of ONE small low-profile themed rim around a black hole. This is a designed hollow game skin, not an ordinary closed object.
Composition: centered isolated asset, orthographic three-quarter view from 55 degrees above the ground, entire silhouette visible, fills about 76 percent of the image. Same framing as a premium collectible game icon. The center is a large, unmistakable completely black open void, with width at least half the outer width, showing no bottom, contents, platform, character, or object across it. The void sits at ground level. All theme geometry frames its outer edge; nothing blocks swallowing.
Style: polished rounded stylized 3D sculpt, beautiful but restrained Common-tier construction, thick readable forms, bevels, a few material regions, appealing craftsmanship. Distinct authored silhouette, not a plain torus with a recolor. Fine detail subordinate to large readable forms. Soft warm key upper left, cool fill right, controlled material highlights, contact shadows on a uniform very pale blue-gray studio floor (#EDF1F5). No scenery.
Only show the idle design. No particle effects or floating decorative props. No text, number, UI, border, logos, watermark or rarity badge. No luminous magical effects. Original design, no licensed characters.
